message.content:
The issue is that the lexer returns `Option<Result<Token>>` but the parser expects `Result<Token>`. I need to handle the error case properly. Let me fix this by using `?` to propagate the error.
</think>

function.name: str_replace_editor

extras.diff:
--- /app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs
+++ /app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs
@@ -53 +53,5 @@
-        self.lexer.next().ok_or_else(|| errinput!("unexpected end of input"))
+        match self.lexer.next() {
+            Some(Ok(t)) => Ok(t),
+            Some(Err(e)) => Err(e),
+            None => Err(errinput!("unexpected end of input")),
+        }
